comment: Submission manifest. A static site has no directory listing, so this file is how the gallery finds entries. Add one object per submission; `entry` is the page the viewer loads. See SPEC.md for what a submission must contain.

submissions.title: GPT-5.6 Sol · Extra High solution
submissions.notes: A measured east-to-west WebGL reconstruction; the layered flat roof and abstract cherubim are disclosed interpretive choices.

submissions.title: A Walkthrough in Cubits
submissions.notes: Hand-written WebGL, no libraries and no assets — every texture is generated in code. The roof is flat and the boards half a cubit thick because those are the values that make the curtain arithmetic of Exodus 26 close exactly; every other point where scripture is silent is flagged in that object's own panel.
